assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
This service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent syncope and palpitations documented in the clinical indication
directly addressing the concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
